newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak bank posts SKK 401.6 mln 96 net-IAS.
newsitem.headline: Slovak bank posts SKK 401.6 mln 96 net-IAS.

text.p: Slovenska Sporitelna a.s., Slovakia's largest savings bank, posted a net profit for 1996 of 401.6 million crowns, calculated according to international accounting standards (IAS), company spokesman Stanislav Krizan said on Monday.
Comparative IAS results were not immediately available but the bank posted a 670.4 million crown net profit, calculated according to Slovak accounting standards, in 1995.
